music.name: Full Burn, Arp sound DMX10 (film cut)
music.note: Times are seconds from the first music sample. After the band hit, bar n starts at band_hit + n * bar.

shots.name: sunrise
shots.desc: A wide flyby of CVN-90 Stormhaven at dawn: in from high off the stern, closing down her port side and past the bow, the whole ship, the sea and the horizon in the frame.

shots.name: cic
shots.desc: Inside the carrier's control room: the radar operator calls the contacts, the supervisor sounds the alert, the commander sends the alert fighters.

shots.name: deck
shots.desc: One take on the flight deck: knee height ahead of the jets in the steam, a crane move to the shooter as the klaxon goes, his run-up and launch signals, then a swing onto Viper 1 as the catapult fires and it roars past.
shots.rig: dolly on deck, crane to the shooter, panning with the launch

shots.name: chase
shots.desc: On the band hit: chasing Viper 1 off the bow, then the camera jet swings out and forward round the pair until it looks back at both NF-24s skimming the sea, the carrier behind them.

shots.name: skim
shots.desc: Skimming the waves: the pair close from behind, pass overhead in humid air with vapour cones on their backs, and climb away toward the bandits.

shots.name: cockpit
shots.desc: In the cockpit of Viper 1, the head-up display and the NF-24 panel: low over the sea, the pull-up, the KS-55 and the drone grow from dots, flash past at the merge, and Viper 1 rolls into the break.

shots.name: fight1
shots.desc: On Viper 1's wing: fox two, the KS-55 fans out flares and the missile takes them. The camera falls back and holds both jets as Viper 1 stays in the bandit's turn, cuts across its reversal and fires again. Splash one.
shots.rig: camera jet on the wing, falling back into a wide chase

shots.name: fight2
shots.desc: From a camera jet alongside: the drone fires at Viper 2, flares and a hard break, the missile misses; the drone overshoots and the two reverse across each other in a flat scissors until Viper 2 is on the guns.
shots.rig: camera jet abeam, pacing the fight

shots.name: pursuit
shots.desc: Over Viper 2's shoulder: the drone runs for the sunrise, weaving; Viper 1 joins high on the right.

shots.name: lock
shots.desc: In Viper 2's cockpit: the drone runs for the sunrise, jinking, Viper 1 joins on the right, the lock closes and Viper 2 fires.

shots.name: finale
shots.desc: Behind Viper 2, into the sun: the missile hits on bar 13 (34.24 s), the Vipers split, and the fire and smoke drift together into TAILON LOCK, a cloud in the dawn sky; it vaporizes as the camera tilts down to the wreck splashing into the sea.
shots.rig: camera jet in trail, then hovering

cards.speaker: RADAR
cards.text: BOGEYS! TWO CONTACTS, BEARING 3-5-0, CLOSING FAST.
MERGED  -  KS-55 GRIFON  +  DR-7 VESPER DRONE
VIPER 2, DEFENDING, DRONE ON MY SIX!
